journey.name: review Earn receiving details
journey.description: Use an onboarded wallet with a Pubky identity and configured USDT. Use a local test auth request; cancel before Authorize so no receiving details or session are exported.

actions.action: Open the existing watch-only setup fixture with x-bitkit-claim=usdt-address-v1
Verify the Earn USDT introduction, then tap Approve
Verify only USDT Arbitrum details, the existing address and balance/history disclosure are shown
Expand the address and copy it; verify it matches the wallet receive address
Cancel and verify no Bitcoin account was created
Repeat with x-bitkit-claim=watch-only-account-v1.usdt-address-v1; verify Bitcoin and USDT appear together, then cancel
Repeat with x-bitkit-claim=watch-only-account-v1; verify only Bitcoin is requested, then cancel
With USDT unavailable, verify sharing is off and authorization remains enabled; turn USDT sharing on and verify authorization is disabled until Retry loads the address
Continue to authorization; verify the Bitcoin account, Paykit access, and optional USDT sharing toggle are shown
Turn off PubkyAuthShareUsdt; verify authorization remains enabled, then cancel
